```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats support the federal government paying 100 percent of the cost for COBRA insurance for people who risk losing their insurance coverage if they lose their jobs in this pandemic and in President Trump's recession.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support re-opening the Affordable Care Act marketplaces, even outside of the normal open enrollment season.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support expanding subsidies to make it easier for people to buy health coverage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support making available on the marketplace a public option administered through the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) which includes a platinum-level choice, with low fees and no deductibles.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Low-income Americans will be automatically enrolled in the public option at zero cost to them, though they may choose to opt out at any time.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These emergency measures will be kept in place until the pandemic ends and unemployment falls significantly.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Should the United States find itself in another pandemic or severe economic downturn in the future, these protections will be made automatically available.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
